en: Sahetukaduka, Hetuduka (The Dyads on Having a Root-Cause, and the Dyads on Root-Causes)
Dependent on a state that has a root and is accompanied by a root, a state that is neither accompanied by a root nor a root arises by way of root-condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is rootless and has a root, a state that is neither rootless nor a root arises by way of root-condition … three.

(Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are six; under object-condition there are three … pe … under mutuality-condition there are four … pe … under resultant-condition there are three … pe … under non-disappearance-condition there are six.
Dependent on a state that has a cause and is not itself a cause, there arises a state that is neither without cause nor a cause, by way of the root condition.

(Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are three; under the object condition, five; under the predominance condition, one … pe … under conascence and mutuality, five … pe … under prenascence and repetition, three … pe … under resultant, three … pe … under non-disappearance, five.
